correctness.rationale: All homomorphisms of unequal cyclic prime-power factors have a unique four-parameter form. Squaring yields four necessary and sufficient congruences; odd-p decomposition is exhaustive because 2 is a unit; binary unit-square fibers and low-exponent root types are exhaustively partitioned. Direct squaring checker verifies 27 distinct parameter instances. Infinite statement rests on the written proof, not checker alone.

value.rationale: An exact element-order invariant across infinitely many automorphism groups, with a sharp prime-two gap threshold (one, two, at least three) and exceptional small cyclic-factor sizes, contrasts with uniform odd-prime behavior. Neither standard total group order nor fixed-point multiplicity contains this information directly. Natural application to order-two actions on mixed cyclic p-groups.
